inputs.text: They’re turning plastic bottles in rivers and drains into a convenient excuse for another tax. The real question is still where the money already collected has gone—and why the problem was allowed to worsen. This looks less like a plan to fix anything than a way to keep collecting while avoiding accountability. Don’t trust a new charge dressed up as environmental concern.
